```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Load libraries
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(magrittr)

```

# Data summary
```{r, echo = FALSE}
## Table containing row counts, missing-value counts, mean, median, standard deviation.
summary_stats <- params$screenData %>%
  group_by(experimentID) %>%
  summarise(
    row_count     = n(),
    missing_count = sum(is.na(viab_norm)),
    mean_viab     = mean(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_viab   = median(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_viab       = sd(viab_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable(summary_stats, caption = "Summary Statistics by Experiment ID")
```
## Box plot of raw data values by plate
```{r, echo = FALSE}

df <- params$screenData
df$y = as.factor(df$experimentID)
#if log10, adjust x
if (!params$log10) {
    df$x <- df$raw_count
    xlab <- "Raw Count"
} else {
    df$x <- log(df$raw_count, base = 10)
    xlab <- "Raw Count (scaled by log10)"
}

ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "royalblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Raw Count Distribution by Experiment",
    x = xlab,
    y = "Experiment ID"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Quality Control metrics
## Z-prime Factor (requires positive and negative)
```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Check if positive controls exist in the dataset
has_pos_control <- "control" %in% names(params$screenData) &&
                   any(params$screenData$control == "pos", na.rm = TRUE)

if (has_pos_control) {
  # Path 1: Positive controls exist -> Calculate all 4 metrics
  metrics_df <- params$screenData %>%
    filter(control %in% c("pos", "neg")) %>%
    group_by(experimentID) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_pos = mean(raw_count[control == "pos"], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_pos   = sd(raw_count[control == "pos"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_neg = mean(raw_count[control == "neg"], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_neg   = sd(raw_count[control == "neg"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      z_prime  = 1 - (3 * (sd_pos + sd_neg)) / abs(mean_pos - mean_neg),
      stb      = mean_pos / mean_neg,
      cv_pos   = 100 * sd_pos / mean_pos,
      cv_neg   = 100 * sd_neg / mean_neg
    )

  cat("### Assay Quality Metrics (Z-prime, Signal-to-Background, & CV)\n")
  print(kable(metrics_df, caption = "Comprehensive Quality Metrics per Experiment"))

} else {
  # Path 2: No positive controls -> Calculate CV for negative controls only
  metrics_df <- params$screenData %>%
    filter(control == "neg") %>%
    group_by(experimentID) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_neg = mean(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_neg   = sd(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      cv_neg = 100 * sd_neg / mean_neg
    )

  cat("### Assay Quality Metrics (Negative Control CV)\n")
  cat("> *Note: Positive control wells ('pos') were not found in the dataset. Z-prime and Signal-to-Background require positive controls; showing Coefficient of Variation for negative controls only.*\n\n")
  print(kable(metrics_df, caption = "Negative Control CV per Experiment"))
}
```
